title: Æbleskiver
description: Round, puffy Danish pancakes turned with a knitting needle in a special dimpled pan, scented with cardamom and eaten hot with jam. Makes about 28.
notes: You need an æbleskiver pan — cast iron with seven round wells. A takoyaki pan works too.

ingredients.name: butter
ingredients.note: melted, plus more for the pan

steps.text: Whisk the flour, baking powder, baking soda, sugar, cardamom, and salt. Beat in the egg yolks, buttermilk, melted butter, and lemon zest to a smooth batter.
Whisk the egg whites to stiff peaks and fold them in.
steps.tip: The whites are what make them hollow and light. Fold, do not stir.

steps.text: Heat the pan and brush each well with butter. Fill each almost to the top.
As the edges set, turn each ball a quarter-turn with a knitting needle or skewer, letting the raw batter run into the well, and keep turning until round and golden all over.
steps.tip: The quarter-turn is the whole technique. The first batch is always lopsided.

steps.text: Dust with powdered sugar and serve hot with the raspberry jam for dipping.
